entries.reason: Single Responsibility — The spec addresses one user-defined concern: improving finalize-merge squash commit messages while preserving related existing contracts.; Task Single Responsibility — Each task addresses a single part of the same concern: subject/fallback construction or preservation of related route contracts.; Unambiguous Requirements — The requirements state concrete subject source order, fallback behavior, footer preservation, and unchanged areas without relying on unverifiable vague adjectives.; Complete Context — The requirements define enough concrete behavior for independent reviewers to decide whether the implementation satisfies them.; REQ Diff-Verifiability — The requirements can be checked from implementation diffs and test summaries covering subject selection, filtering, fallback, and preserved contracts.; No Hardcoded Secrets — The content does not include source code containing API keys, passwords, tokens, or other secrets.; No Silent Error Swallowing — The content does not include catch blocks or error handling code that could silently discard errors.; Prioritize Requirements — There are exactly three requirements, so priority assignment is not required; all three nevertheless include priority values.; Impact on Existing Features — The spec lists effects on existing behavior, including preserved Issue footer handling and unchanged PR route, merge strategy, and custom commit message behavior.; Bounded Resource Usage — baseBranch..featureBranch の commit subjects から finalize 生成 commit を除外した最新 subject を使う — This describes loading or scanning commit subjects from a branch range without an explicit upper bound on count or size. (at overview.data_flow[0].text); Bounded Resource Usage — `baseBranch..featureBranch` の commit subjects から finalize 生成 commit を除外した最新 subject を使う — This requirement depends on processing commit subjects from a branch range but does not specify an explicit upper bound. (at requirements[1].desc); Bounded Resource Usage — `baseBranch..featureBranch` の commit subjects を新しい順に見て、finalize が生成する metadata/report subject を除外した最初の subject を使う。 — This clarification specifies scanning commit subjects in order without stating a maximum number of commits or subjects to inspect. (at clarifications[2].a); Bounded Resource Usage — baseBranch..featureBranch の subjects から finalize metadata/report subject を除外して選ぶ。 — This implementation note describes processing branch-range subjects without an explicit upper bound on the amount of data processed.
